name: @kruddage/engine
description: The KRUDD engine as an npm package: builds the WASM module through kruddmake and publishes the resulting artifacts behind a declared API.
//exports: Two entry points, and the split is load-bearing rather than tidy. The root is build-time code: it reads the filesystem to find artifacts, and it imports node:fs and node:path to do it. ./bridge is runtime code that ships to a browser, and it imports nothing at all. Merging them would mean a bundler pulling node:fs into the editor to get at the boundary client (#945).
